prompt.task: Complete the entire login for Default Browser and go to store.steampowered.com/login/ in one continuous flow. First open Default Browser and go to store.steampowered.com/login/. Enter {user} as username. Enter {password} as password; if a password is not needed, just ignore it. Continue until a push notification has been sent or a message saying to check your phone / approve the login is visible. If a number is visible on screen before you leave, remember it. Then open the Steam app. If a push notification approval screen is visible, approve it. If a number input field is visible, type in the number you saw on the previous screen. After approving or entering the number, switch back to Default Browser and go to store.steampowered.com/login/. If a prompt appears such as 'Is this your device?', click Yes or Trust this browser. Wait 2 seconds and confirm login succeeded. Do not report success unless the screen shows a post-login state or the main page.

auto_verifier.reason: The start capture does not show Steam authenticated and the log records a continuous {user} credential/push-approval flow, but the controller-owned final screenshot/XML show only a generic Steam storefront behind a DuckDuckGo Fireproof dialog, with no {user} identity or account-only content; the runner's final assertion is therefore uncorroborated.
